• CVE-2026-76519 — Cisco Secure Email Gateway, EPSS 2%
• CVE-2026-96951 — Microsoft Windows, EPSS 2%
• CVE-2026-0322 — Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS, EPSS 1%
…and 4 more.
